boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Named stops on the Campus Corner streets immediately north of the University of Oklahoma’s Norman campus.

cards.title: Pepe Delgados: Mexican Menu
cards.subtitle: Asp Avenue corridor, Campus Corner
cards.notes: Walk the Asp Avenue corridor to this named Campus Corner restaurant and review its current menu before choosing a meal.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepe Delgados identifies itself as a Mexican restaurant in historic Campus Corner; the Campus Corner Association lists it at 786 Asp Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant; confirm current service details directly before visiting.

cards.title: Tea Cafe on the Corner: Boba and Asian Fusion

cards.evidence_claim: Tea Cafe on the Corner describes itself as offering Asian fusion and boba on Asp Avenue in Campus Corner.
cards.access_notes: Food-and-beverage business; check the official site for current details.

cards.evidence_claim: Louie’s lists its Campus Corner location at 301 W. Boyd Street and says it is on the north edge of the University of Oklahoma campus.
cards.source_title: Louie's Grill & Bar — Norman Campus Corner
cards.access_notes: Restaurant; consult the official location page for current hours and menu.
